October · first fire

Sweep done in August,
so you're in the clear

The first frosty morning is just a match away. If your sweep happened in August or September, the flue is clean, the cap is on, and the draft is right. If it didn't, book now — the fall waitlist fills by mid-October.

January · midwinter check

The pipe and cap checked,
swept if they need it

For houses that heat with wood: a camera look up the flue in January catches creosote buildup before the coldest stretch. Findings come back as fine, watch, or fix — with photos from inside your chimney.

Inspection camera view of flue tile interior

Fine

Liner intact, no cracks or gaps

Watch

Light stage-1 soot; sweep at season end

Fix

Cap mesh bent; replace before nesting season

Wood stove insert fitted into an existing masonry fireplace

07

July · install window

Stoves and inserts fitted
while the roof is dry

Summer is when there's time to do it slowly. A stainless liner runs the whole way down, the cold draft from the old fireplace is gone, and the new stove draws right from the first fire in October.

Before you call

Check it yourself

Is my firewood dry enough?

Dry wood reads under 20% on a fresh split face. Wet wood builds creosote faster.

How often should I sweep?

Heavy burners may need twice a year. Weekend fires usually mean once.

Do you cover my town?
